scope: Read-only comparison of 42 embedded source blocks against two manifests and current source bytes; known-identity text scan; no PDE, no DOCX/PDF visual inspection, no metadata-anonymity or human-review certification. Only these QA reports are written.
encodingConvention: Source raw-byte SHA256 must match manifest. Embedded code must equal UTF-8-decoded source after only BOM removal and CRLF/CR to LF normalization; even terminal blank lines are compared. Normalized text SHA256 is recorded separately, never substituted for raw-source SHA.

anonymityScan.limit: Known usernames/schools, Windows user paths, emails and repository identifiers only; this is not a guarantee against every possible indirect identifying detail. Generic D:/Document/数学建模/2026CUMCM paths contain no inspected identity token.
